description: Determination as to whether prior approval is required for change of use from commercial space Class E at first-floor to one residential flat Class C3.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - This notice indicates that the proposed development would comply with conditions G.1 of Schedule 2 Part 3 Class G of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (as amended) ("the GPDO"). 
It is a requirement of condition G.1(c) that a flat provided by change of use under Class G must not be used otherwise than as a dwelling (whether or not as a sole or main residence) -
(i) by a single person or by people living together as a family, or
(ii) by not more than 6 residents living together as a single household (including a household where care is provided for residents)

For the purposes of Class G, care means personal care for people in need of such care by reason of old age, disablement, past or present dependence on alcohol or drugs or past or present mental disorder.

It is a requirement of paragraph W(12) of the GPDO that the development is carried out in accordance with the details provided in the application unless the developer and the local planning authority agree in writing.
Condition : 2 - Prior to first occupation of the development, details of the siting, design and materials of refuse and recycling storage to serve the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The refuse storage facilities shall be provided in accordance with the approved details prior to occupation of the development, and shall be retained thereafter.
Reason: In the interests of amenity and hygiene, in accordance with Council policy LP1 and LP2 of the Local Plan, the Councils Refuse and Recylables SPD coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 3 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the sound insulation scheme and venitation system as indicated  under section 5 of the submitted Noise Impact Assessment by Infinity Acoustics (Project reference number: A439OA version number 001 dated: 09/06/2026). The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved scheme prior to first occupation and be so retained.
Reason: To protect the occupiers of the building, in accordance with Council policies  LP2, LP14 and LP27 of the Local Plan  coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework. The details are required prior to commencement of development to ensure the necessary mitigation is incorporated into the construction.
